_doc: The script as the GPU engine reads it (scripts/gpu_batches.py, scripts/fit_lines.py): who says what, how, and what we see in each take.

agency.who: The marketing agency account manager in a navy blazer

lines.text: Hey... I think we should break up.
lines.action: serious and a little nervous, he takes a small breath before speaking

lines.text: You're breaking up... with your marketing agency?
lines.action: shocked and incredulous, leaning slightly toward the camera

lines.text: It's not you. It's your invoices.
lines.acting: calm and sympathetic, tilting his head
lines.action: calm and sympathetic, tilting his head slightly

lines.text: Wow.
lines.action: offended; she says one word, then blinks slowly and stares in hurt silence with pursed lips

lines.text: Fine. But who's going to answer all your questions?
lines.action: regaining her confidence, a little threatening, raising one eyebrow

lines.text: I don't know...
lines.acting: faking worry with a small shrug
lines.action: faking worry with a small shrug; right after the line the phone in his hands lights up, he glances down at it and quickly flips it face down against his chest, then looks back up innocently

lines.text: Who's going to reply to your reviews?
lines.action: pressing on, confident and a little smug

lines.text: No idea.
lines.acting: innocent, then clears his throat with a small cough
lines.action: innocent; right after the line he clears his throat with a small cough and looks away

lines.text: Who's going to post on your Instagram?
lines.action: glancing down suspiciously at his phone, then back at the camera

lines.text: Not a clue.
lines.acting: innocent, then whistles quietly looking to the side
lines.action: innocent; right after the line he purses his lips and whistles quietly, looking to the side

lines.text: Who's going to get you to the top of Google Maps?
lines.action: playing her last card, slow and serious

lines.text: Honestly? Absolutely no idea.
lines.acting: sips a protein shake, cannot hide a smile
lines.action: trying to look worried; right after the line he takes a sip from the protein shaker and cannot hide a growing smile

lines.text: Wait... are you seeing someone else?
lines.action: narrowing her eyes, suspicious, leaning in slightly

lines.text: What? ... What? No.
lines.action: pretending to be offended, eyebrows raised

lines.text: Then who keeps texting you?
lines.action: accusing, eyes narrowed

lines.text: It's... just an app.
lines.action: embarrassed, with a sheepish smile, he lifts the phone a little in one hand, its back toward the camera so the screen is never visible

lines.text: You're leaving us... for an app?!
lines.action: shouting, outraged, leaning toward the camera

lines.text: It replies at two a.m. You reply in five business days.
lines.action: with a casual shrug

lines.text: Fine. You'll come crawling back. Don't even think about calling me.
lines.acting: points her finger, leans into the camera, then turns and walks out of frame
lines.action: angry; she points her finger at the camera and leans in, then turns around and walks out of the frame, leaving the gym

lines.text: What? Babe, no! Come back!
lines.action: in exaggerated fake despair, reaching one hand after her

lines.text: Hey, you.
lines.acting: silent joy, then softly to the phone
lines.prompt: Single continuous handheld vertical smartphone shot, no cuts, camera at eye level facing him, slight natural handheld movement, the framing stays the same with no zoom and no push-in. The bearded gym owner stands alone in his small gym after she has left. For a moment he is still, then he throws his head back and spreads his arms wide in pure joy with a big grin. Then the phone in his hand buzzes, he looks down at it and softly says something to it with a tender smile. Natural, understated comedic acting. No other people, no text on screen.
